Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the initial search results, which clearly showed that “Gently My Songs Entreat” (Leise flehen meine Lieder, 1933) was directed by Willi Forst, and instead incorrectly pivoted to the English-language version “Unfinished Symphony” and its director Anthony Asquith. This unresolved ambiguity and misattribution led the workflow to pursue the wrong director’s birthplace (London for Asquith) rather than Willi Forst’s (Vienna), directly causing the incorrect solution.
